Class OffHeapLongIntMapImpl

java.lang.Object
express.mvp.roray.ffm.ds.map.OffHeapLongIntMapImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
OffHeapLongIntMap, AutoCloseable
public class OffHeapLongIntMapImpl extends Object implements OffHeapLongIntMap
A linear-probing, open-addressing hash map with off-heap keys and off-heap int values.

Not thread-safe. Designed for single-threaded hot paths.

  • Constructor Details

    • OffHeapLongIntMapImpl

      public OffHeapLongIntMapImpl(int capacity)
      Creates a new off-heap long-to-int map with specified capacity.

      Arena ownership: This map owns its arena. Calling close() closes the arena and releases all off-heap storage.

      Parameters:
      capacity - the capacity (must be a power of 2)

    • OffHeapLongIntMapImpl

      public OffHeapLongIntMapImpl(int capacity, Arena arena)
      Creates a new off-heap long-to-int map using a caller-provided Arena.

      Arena ownership: The map does not own the provided arena. Calling close() will release this map instance, but will not close the arena. The caller remains responsible for closing the arena.

      Parameters:
      capacity - the capacity (must be a power of 2)
      arena - the arena to allocate the off-heap storage from (caller-owned)

  • Method Details

    • getPacked

      public long getPacked(long key)
      Description copied from interface: OffHeapLongIntMap
      Gets the value for the given key in a packed format.
      Specified by:
      getPacked in interface OffHeapLongIntMap
      Parameters:
      key - The key.
      Returns:
      A packed long where bit 63 (MSB) is the "found" flag and bits 0-31 contain the int value. If the key is not found, the MSB is 0. Example: 
      long packed = map.getPacked(key);
boolean found = packed < 0;   // MSB (bit 63) set => negative => found
if (found) {
    int value = (int) packed; // low 32 bits
    // use value
}

    • probeForPut

      protected final long probeForPut(long key)
      Returns a packed long where the sign bit indicates whether the key already exists.

      If found, result < 0 and (int) result is the existing index.

      If not found, result >= 0 and (int) result is an insertion slot.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the table is full
